jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve + lighting-weather. Asset type: transparent full-body game character with a small ground contact mound. Image 1 is the EXACT Sun King design to preserve; image 2 is only the photographic wet dusk farmland lighting/material reference. Re-render the SAME Sun King with the SAME crouching pose, proportions, mischievous huge toothy laughing grin, face marks, eyes, swept spiky black hair, pointed ears and gold earring, ornate black-and-gold flame/cloud cape, cream cloud curls, red and gold embroidered cloth, cream trousers, exact bead necklaces and sun medallion, gold wrist/ankle bangles, long curled monkey tail, fingers, toes and black nails. Do not add, omit or redesign any identity/costume details. Harmonize only the rendering and illumination with the blue-gray rainy evening farmland: natural detailed fur and fabric texture, softer realistic cool ambient shadow, restrained warm gold reflections, subtle wet sheen, no bright sticker outline, no flat cel-shaded glare. Keep the same recognizable stylized character rather than a different real monkey. Replace ONLY the bright cut-off rectangular rock slab under his feet and hand with a LOW natural mound of dark rain-soaked brown earth, small embedded weathered stones, tufts of wet grass and a little field soil at its perimeter, matching the farmland reference. Preserve the positions where his feet and lowered hand meet the ground and support all those contact points. Mound must be low and horizontal in the reference scene's camera perspective, with realistic contact shadow; its entire perimeter must end organically with irregular soil and sparse grass fading into TRUE alpha, including a visible transparent margin below it. NO flat horizontal cut along the bottom, NO rectangular platform, NO floating slab. Entire combined character+mound isolated on genuine transparent background, full pose and tail visible, portrait composition matching image 1 with a small safety margin. No field background, no road, no pole, no rain streaks, no lighting bolts, no text. Sun King's defining expression is a delighted mischievous 'ki ki ki' laugh; keep the exact grin design, never a neutral or angry mouth.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit the provided Sun King character + mud mound image into an EXACT character-only transparent layer for a game. Remove ONLY the earth/stone/grass mound below his feet and lowered hand. Keep the complete Sun King pixel-aligned in its ORIGINAL full 1199x1312 canvas: identical pose, face and huge toothy laughing grin, all fur, flame cape, cloud curls, tail, costume embroidery, bead necklaces, gold jewelry, every finger, toe and black nail. Preserve all edge details and the precise original locations and proportions; do not redraw, relight, resize, center or crop. All soil, stones, grass and ground shadows must be removed to genuine alpha; the spaces between fingers/toes remain transparent where appropriate, but never cut off nails or feet. Keep cool dusk material rendering exactly as supplied. No new objects, no new background, no text. Full-size transparent character-only extraction, with no ground whatsoever.

Use case: precise-object-edit + background-extraction. Edit the provided Sun King + earth mound image into ONLY its LOW WET EARTH MOUND layer. Completely remove the entire character (head, hair, costume, cape, clouds, tail, all hands, feet and nails) and reconstruct the small portions of earth hidden beneath his ground-contact feet and hand. No tall rock slab, no rectangular edge, no new terrain elsewhere, no background, no rain, no text. The empty earth mound must remain at exactly the same coordinates for the unchanged character layer to stand on it. Do not zoom, center or crop the mound.

Use case: background-extraction. Create ONE exact HEAD-ONLY transparent layer from the provided Sun King character. Maintain the entire ORIGINAL 1108x1420 canvas and head's EXACT pixel position and size; do not crop, center, enlarge or redesign. Extract only his complete spiky black hair, monkey face, broad toothy laughing grin, pointed ear and gold hoop earring, cheeks/jaw/beard fur, ending at the natural narrow neck junction. Remove ALL other character parts to genuine alpha: no necklaces, no torso, no arms, no cape, no large cream decorative cloud swirls behind the head, no black/gold flame cape background, no tail, no legs, no mound. Preserve original detailed cool dusk rendering, every face marking, hair strand, facial proportions and jewelry shape exactly. Head remains tilted at exactly its original angle, with the same open-eyed playful mischievous 'ki ki ki' grin. No new objects or text. This is an alignment-critical extracted sprite on a full original canvas, not a portrait redraw.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided Sun King character into its HEADLESS BODY layer for an articulated game puppet. Remove ONLY the head: spiky scalp hair, face, ear, earring, beard/jaw head fur. Reconstruct a very small natural neck/upper-chest attachment patch formerly hidden by the head, retaining nearby necklaces and shoulder silhouette so a separate unchanged head can be placed over it. KEEP ALL other parts exactly as supplied at their exact original positions: every bead necklace and sun medallion, torso, both arms/hands, all fingers/nails, both legs/feet, cream trousers, red/gold embroidered cloth, bangles, the entire black/gold flame cape and cream cloud curls behind the head, and long curled tail. No ground or soil, no background, true alpha transparency throughout the removed head area and outside the body, no replacement head, no new objects, no text.
